visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman wearing a white baseball cap, a grey off-the-shoulder top, and wide-leg denim jeans stands in an indoor retail environment. She holds a small child in a blue floral dress on her right hip. In front of them is a large, stainless steel Coca-Cola soda fountain machine with several dispensers and red branding. The woman holds a large red cup, looks at the camera with a wide smile, and then takes a sip. (2) The camera maintains a medium shot as animated graphics of a blue Pepsi can and a red Coca-Cola can appear on the lower left and right of the frame. The woman looks expressive, looking directly at the camera with wide eyes and a slightly open mouth as if asking a question. The background remains the bright, industrial interior of a warehouse-style store with high ceilings and fluorescent lighting. (3) The scene cuts to an outdoor parking lot under bright, direct sunlight. The woman walks toward the camera across the grey asphalt, still carrying the child and the red cup. In the background, several white vans and cars are parked next to a concrete building with a large 'COSTCO WHOLESALE' entrance sign and green Japanese text on the pillars.
